messages:
Maya: quick follow-up from today's pm on the cache-eviction incident. I pulled the action items into a short list — please claim owners and set ETA. cc @samira @luis :eyes:

Maya: actions:
- RDW-2456: add cache TTL metrics + alerting (engine)
- RDW-2461: evergreen eviction regression test (runtime)
- RDW-2467: docs + runbook update (ops)
- RDW-2472: investigate recurring pattern (postmortem research)

Maya: propose RACI for now: RDW-2456 (R: Luis, A: Maya, C: Eugene, I: Ops)
RDW-2461 (R: ???, A: Eng-ML lead, C: Runtime eng, I: SRE)
RDW-2467 (R: Samira, A: Product ops, C: Eng, I: Support)
RDW-2472 (R: TBD, A: Research lead, C: Eng-ML, I: PM)

Luis: I'll take RDW-2456. ETA end of week unless something blocks. I'll add notes to the ticket and a quick dashboard query.

Samira: happy to own RDW-2467 (docs/runbook). I can push a draft by Wed. Will need the new alert thresholds from Luis to update examples.

Eugene: +1 on the RACI structure. For RDW-2472 I can be C for the investigation, suggest we split it into two tickets: exploratory (spike) + remediation backlog item. Keeps timelines sane.

Tina: heads-up — runtime team is short this sprint. RDW-2461 might be delayed if it stays with runtime. @Samira can you triage whether the eviction regression test can be a collaborative ticket (runtime + eng-ml) so we can share work?

Samira: yep I can coordinate. @Tina can you and one runtime dev pair with me Thurs for 2-3h? I can draft test plan beforehand.

Tina: sure. Adding 2h pairing on Thu to my calendar. If runtime can't spare devs, we'll reassign the R to Eng-ML.

Maya: OK sounds good. Updated ETAs in the thread: RDW-2456 (Luis) EOW, RDW-2467 (Samira) Wed, RDW-2461 (tentative) next sprint unless runtime confirms pairing. RDW-2472 (Eugene spike) 2w box.

Luis: posted link to dashboard query in RDW-2456. Also added alert thresholds (draft). Please review and thumbs up if ok.

Samira: looked — thresholds seem reasonable. I'll include the snippet in the runbook.

incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem doc uploaded -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/Cache+Eviction+Postmortem. Auto-created ticket RDW-2456, RDW-2461, RDW-2467, RDW-2472.

Maya: action items assigned, thanks. I'll follow up with a weekly check-in on Friday to move stalled items. If anyone needs to reassign, reply here and update the ticket owner field. :thumbsup:
